instruction: Extract all explicitly supported atomic software requirements from the stakeholder input. Preserve exact source traceability and do not introduce unsupported functionality.
input: Operations meeting note: Dispatch needs to see all open delivery exceptions and may reassign a stop when another driver is available. Route planning and traffic optimization are outside this project.

instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief: RouteRelay Exception Board provides a shared workflow for recording, reassigning, and resolving failed delivery attempts. Drivers record a failure reason and note, dispatch coordinators view open exceptions and reassign stops, customer service agents record the customer's preferred next step, and warehouse clerks record returned parcels at the depot. Dispatch closes an exception only after a parcel return is recorded or a new delivery is completed. Replacement drivers must be notified after reassignment, although the notification channel has not been chosen. Route planning and traffic optimization are excluded.

output.summary: RouteRelay Exception Board provides a shared workflow for recording, reassigning, and resolving failed delivery attempts. Drivers, Dispatch Coordinators, Customer Service Agents, and Warehouse Clerks handle exception details, reassignment, customer preferences, parcel returns, and closure under a confirmed completion rule. Replacement Drivers must be notified after reassignment, but the notification channel remains unresolved; route planning and traffic optimization are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Provide a shared workflow for recording, reassigning, and resolving failed delivery attempts.
key_capabilities: Record delivery-failure reasons and driver notes
Record the customer's preferred next step
Record returned parcels at the depot
Close exceptions after a recorded return or completed new delivery
unresolved_points: The notification channel for replacement Drivers has not been chosen.

instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Kickoff notes: The project is called RouteRelay Exception Board, and its objective is to provide a shared workflow for recording, reassigning, and resolving failed delivery attempts. A Driver records the reason and note for an unsuccessful attempt. A Dispatch Coordinator views open exceptions, reassigns a stop when another driver is available, and closes an exception only after a return is recorded or a new delivery is completed. A Customer Service Agent records the customer's preferred next step, and a Warehouse Clerk records when a returned parcel reaches the depot. The available failure reasons and the replacement-driver notification channel are not yet specified. Route planning and traffic optimization are not in scope.
